observes: Full run of models/semantics after review 4 (R4-08): harness complement check added (check_keep: every safety law of the underlying model explored alone and recorded in RESULTS.json 'violates'/'also_violates'); new trait instances result-cache-04, adjacency-no-lock-mark, bm25-index-graph-unchecked, ivf-index-graph-unchecked (instances split so each object's model shows only its own variants). 272 of 272 checks met, all exhaustive within declared bounds, complements exhaustive (none truncated): as-built 102 plus 2 exception, reviewed 109 (including sharpness), controls 59. Of the 140 violation checks run through Keep, 58 also violate another law (as-built 38 of 82, exception 1 of 2, controls 19 of 56); no reviewed check violates any law. Model-level results only.
